stops.title: Dumpling House
stops.alt: Mana Azizsoltani with companions in a car in San Francisco
stops.blurb: Aunty Nani and I were going to take a bus ride from Sacramento to San Francisco, but it got cancelled. So we had to get an Uber and made some friends along the way! We had lunch with Philip and Hannah at Dumpling House and barely made it on time.

stops.title: The Painted Ladies
stops.alt: Mana Azizsoltani with a companion overlooking San Francisco’s Painted Ladies
stops.blurb: Aunty Nani and I started at the Painted Ladies. Thankfully, Philip and Hannah took us up the hill so we didn’t have to hike it up the gnarly SF hills.

stops.title: The flower garden
stops.alt: Mana Azizsoltani and a companion in a San Francisco flower garden
stops.blurb: We stopped at the flower conservatory. Sometimes you have to stop and smell the ... dahlias?

stops.title: A coffee stop
stops.alt: Mana Azizsoltani and a companion holding coffee in San Francisco
stops.blurb: Pooped from walking, we stopped by the museums and had a coffee and listened to the reggae music in the park. The coffee energized us to keep going.

stops.title: A heron along the way
stops.alt: A heron standing among trees in San Francisco
stops.blurb: We saw a real-life heron... in the wild... and he (or she) just stood there watching us.

stops.title: Time for a cartwheel
stops.alt: Mana Azizsoltani doing a cartwheel in San Francisco
stops.blurb: WE MADE IT!!! We made it all the way to the ocean. I did a cartwheel with the windmills behind to celebrate the victory.

stops.title: Out with Philip
stops.alt: Mana Azizsoltani and Philip in San Francisco
stops.blurb: I stayed the night and hung out with Philip for the day. We didn’t take any pictures except for this hasty selfie as we were booking it to the BART stop for me to be on my way.

stops.alt: Travelers waiting at airport gate G6
